change.what: JsonlConfiguredConnectorStore remembers file identity (inode, size, mtime_ns) and byte offset and applies only appended complete lines; a replaced, truncated, same-size-rewritten or removed journal falls back to a full replay. Returned configs and fetch states are deep copies so callers cannot alter the cache.
change.not_changed: what is written to connector_config.jsonl, row caps, the 30 s run-scheduled bound, memory limits, reconcile/readback code, any persisted format (previous release reads the file unchanged)

diagnosis_acceptance_1.hosted_ratio: hosted reconcile median 44 s (reported by the coordinator) vs 15.05 s here is about 2.9 times; consistent with the same cause on a slower CPU. Not re-measured by this task.

acceptance.2_unchanged_reconcile_at_most_5s: 0.14 s wall (0.35 s profiled) on the fixture; first reconcile after a large outside append 1.3 s once. Payload equals a full-replay-per-call run (test_unchanged_reconcile_parses_no_journal_and_returns_the_same_payload); changed input (schedule drift) planned payload equals and the real run repairs then settles (test_changed_reconcile_still_repairs_and_payloads_match_a_full_replay).
acceptance.3_outside_run_scheduled_at_most_15s: about 0.9 s here (was about 16 s). Hosted estimate at the 2.9 times ratio: about 2.6 s; not measured.
acceptance.4_no_check_removed: no reconcile, schedule, readback or validation code changed; the store re-stats the journal on every call and reads whatever another writer appended, so nothing is reused across ticks without a fresh stat. Tests append from another store instance and replace/truncate/rewrite the file and compare with a fresh full replay.
acceptance.5_readback_identical: test_controller_readback_payload_equals_full_replay_payload (time-derived fields age_seconds, staleness_seconds, seconds_until_due, max_lag_seconds, captured_at excluded; the clock is fixed for the rest)
acceptance.7_bytes_written_per_tick: 2,135,832 bytes per steady tick before and after (identical; ingest_schedule 10,472, source_evidence 11,758, connector_config 834, latest_market_snapshots 395,520, the rest raw bundle files). No writer added or changed.
acceptance.8_deterministic: tests count journal lines parsed (at most 5 vs at least 100 x journal lines on full replay) and assert no wall time; each new test under 11 s.

memory_note: Replays are transient: one full replay of the 4512-line journal peaks at 8.4 MB and retains 0.8 MB after 50 replays (tracemalloc). They do not explain the reported rise from 1.2 to 2.5 GiB in 48 minutes. The cause of that growth is not found by this task. Replays cost CPU and allocation churn only.
